verdict.rationale: LobeChat's own docs show multiple model backends: self-hosting guides for Azure OpenAI and Ollama, changelog support for Gemini 3.6 Flash, and Kimi K3 listed in a model list. That supports the multi-provider part of the story, but nothing in the evidence shows switching models per agent or per conversation. Missing for 10: evidence for Anthropic and OpenRouter providers, documented per-agent and per-conversation model switching, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can plug in multiple model providers — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, and more — and switch models per agent or per conversation

citations.quote: Gemini 3.6 Flash is now supported in LobeHub with four thinking levels, multimodal input, web search, and tool use.
Kimi K3 exposes reasoning effort controls, and Kimi K3 Fast is described in the model list.
